#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

vector<int> getinput() {
    vector<int> result(2);
    cin >> result[0] >> result[1];
    return result;

long long opow(long long a, long long b, long long mod) {
    long long ans = 1;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b % 2 == 1) {
            ans = (ans * a) % mod;
        }
        a = (a * a) % mod;
        b /= 2;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    vector<int> input = getinput();
    int p = input[0];
    int k = input[1];
    const long long mod = 1000000007;
    long long ans = 0;

    if (k == 0) {
        ans = opow(p, p - 1, mod);
    } else {
        for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
            if ((p - 1) % i == 0 && opow(k, i, p) == 1) {
                ans = opow(p, (p - 1) / i, mod);
                if (k == 1) {
                    ans = (ans * p) % mod;
                }
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
